title: WF03 SCH-04 escalation timer blocker: scheduler error-set mismatch and escalation SQL typing defects

root_cause.description: The SCH-04 escalation path had two source defects in the same scheduler flow: parseEscalationPayload leaked error.InvalidUuid from parseUuid even though its declared error set only allowed OutOfMemory and InvalidPayload, and the escalation timer INSERT reused ambiguous PostgreSQL parameters across interval math and JSON payload construction, causing runtime failures and duration payload drift in focused SCH-04 integration validation.

resolution.summary: Mapped UUID parse failures into the local InvalidPayload error, added explicit text casts and a dedicated duration payload parameter in the escalation timer INSERT, and preserved the original ISO-8601 duration string while keeping interval arithmetic for fire_at/due_at computation.

actions: Map helper/parser errors into module-local error sets at API boundaries so focused compile checks catch mismatches immediately.
When PostgreSQL parameters are reused across typed expressions and JSON builders, cast ambiguous text fields explicitly and avoid reusing interval-bound parameters for literal payload strings.
